_comment: v12.6 instrument locks — frozen audit parameters. Do not modify for official experiments. Any deviation must be documented as a sensitivity analysis.
_q_warn_note: PRIMARY threshold method (design_choices v3): tau_warn = Q_0.95(pilot_D) — quantile of LOO pilot drift scores. EVT and t-interval approaches were superseded. See design_choices_coverage.md C1.
_lambda_FA_note: Diagnostic reference only — target FAR per post-pilot window (Li et al. 2026). Not used directly in threshold computation; tau_warn is set by q_warn quantile. Retained for FAR-budget cross-check in reporting.
_tau_warn_floor_note: Minimum detectable JSD shift. Prevents near-zero tau_warn from LOO pilot calibration on stable policies (K0=4 gives pilot_D ~1e-5; nominal deployment D_k reaches 1e-4 to 1e-3 by natural variability). Set at 2e-4 = ~Q95 of observed nominal D_k across seeds. See tuning_journal.md T-01.
_c_len_note: Sensitivity multiplier for A_len episode-length degradation channel. T_len fires when mean_ep_len_k < mu_len_ref - c_len * sigma_len_ref for m_fail consecutive windows. c_len=2.0 chosen as starting point (symmetric with c_fail=2.0); validated in T-06. Immune to healthy_reward masking (Pardo 2018).
_k_cusum_factor_note: CUSUM slack: k_cusum = k_cusum_factor × σ(pilot_D). Detects sustained upward shifts in D_k. k=0.5σ gives good sensitivity to shifts ≥1σ above pilot baseline.
_h_cusum_factor_note: CUSUM decision threshold: h_cusum = h_cusum_factor × σ(pilot_D). T_cusum fires when cumulative sum S_k > h_cusum. h=5σ gives ARL₀ ≈ 370 windows under baseline (Gaussian increments). Shares the S=25k window granularity floor with T_warn.
